title: Flyboard® Air Test 1
summary: Promotional video from Zapata Racing showing Franky Zapata flying the Flyboard Air prototype, claiming autonomous flight to 10,000 feet, 150 km/h top speed and 10 minutes of endurance.
why: Cited in threads on personal flight and hoverboards as evidence that jet-powered personal flight devices really exist.

quote.text: The "Flyboard Air" is also interesting [0] (and almost definitely not a hoax!).
